This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried 
 out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Galal Essawy, tested by eng. 
Khaled Ahmad El-Sayed, reviewed by eng. Mostafa Mohamed Mostafa, accepted by 
general manager eng. Ahmed Abd El Rahman Ali, revised by EDEPC inspection & quality control eng. 
Nasser Bahgat, approved by eng. Mahmoud El Naqib: head sector of Ayon Mousa PS 
and certified by eng. Soliman Zaki Soliman EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general manager.

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy 
 equipments as safety healthy, safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor on condenser.

Isolate all drain valve to 
 condenser .

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must be completely 
 drainage.
Open manhole on condenser
Complete maintenance tool set.
Main Crane, Alfa Laval,

Manual Puller, Feeler Gauge, Rags, 
 Cleaning Fluid,
Dial Indicator, Vibrometer.

Check leakage water 
 from any connection inlet or outlet of the condenser .

Check discharge quantity and 
 pressure and compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out 
 components (if it is needed).

Check hammering in condenser and 
 all drain to condenser .

Check T.D.S of condensation and PH 
 .

Check bolted ,supported and compare it with the setting 
 value.
Clean hot well and water box tow side.
Check bolts fixation, then retightens it (if it is needed).
Check the leakage from inside tube (if it is needed).
Check the insulation inside water box tow side .
Check flanges for leakage.

Check any corrosion inside water box tow side (if it is 
 needed).
The electrical low vacuum trip setting MAG01 CP 002/3/4=0.3 bar

The electrical low vacuum trip for by pass operation setting 
 MAG01 CP 002/3/4=0.6bar
